title.zh: 将阿尔拜省 Tabaco 市 Ziga 纪念区医院床位由五十（50）张增至两百五十（250）张，更名为 Dr. Lorenzo P. Ziga 纪念区医院并为其拨款
title.en: An Act increasing the Bed Capacity of the Ziga Memorial District Hospital in the City of Tabaco, Province of Albay from Fifty (50) to Two Hundred Fifty (250) Beds, to be now Known as the Dr. Lorenzo P. Ziga Memorial District Hospital, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act increasing the Bed Capacity of the Ziga Memorial District Hospital in the City of Tabaco, Province of Albay from Fifty (50) to Two Hundred Fifty (250) Beds, to be now Known as the Dr. Lorenzo P. Ziga Memorial District Hospital, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tăng sức chứa giường bệnh của Bệnh viện Huyện Tưởng niệm Ziga tại Thành phố Tabaco, Tỉnh Albay từ 50 lên 250 giường, và phân bổ kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเพิ่มจำนวนเตียงของโรงพยาบาลอำเภออนุสรณ์ Ziga ในเมือง Tabaco จังหวัด Albay จาก 50 เป็น 250 เตียง และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang meningkatkan kapasitas tempat tidur Rumah Sakit Distrik Memorial Ziga di Kota Tabaco, Provinsi Albay dari 50 menjadi 250 tempat tidur, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta meningkatkan kapasiti katil Hospital Daerah Memorial Ziga di Bandar Tabaco, Wilayah Albay daripada 50 kepada 250 katil, serta memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Ziga Memorial District Hospital in the City of Tabaco, Province of Albay is hereby renamed as the Dr. Lorenzo P. Ziga Memorial District Hospital, and its authorized bed capacity is hereby increased from fifty (50) to two hundred fifty (250) beds.

The existing hospital facilities and professional health care services of the Dr. Lorenzo P. Ziga Memorial District Hospital are hereby upgraded and increased to conform with and be commensurate to the increased in bed capacity. The number of medical personnel shall be correspondingly increased.
If any provision or part of this Act is declared unconstitutional, the remaining parts or provisions not affected shall remain in full force and effect.
All other laws, decrees, orders, issuances, rules and regulations, or parts thereof which are inconsistent with any provision of this Act are hereby repealed amended or modified accordingly.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
